description: Choose what to scrape: a keyword search, a job role, a country or remote jobs, every active listing, or specific job/search URLs.

compact.description: Omit long job descriptions and company description/perks/gallery/video fields to keep rows small.
compact.title: Compact output

country.description: Country filter. Required for browseByCountry; optional extra filter for searchJobs, browseByRole and allJobs. Choose Remote for remote-only jobs.
country.title: Country

jobRole.description: Legacy role value from older saved tasks. Use the job role dropdown instead.
jobRole.title: Legacy job role

maxItems.description: Hard cap on the number of jobs saved to the dataset.
maxItems.title: Max jobs

mode.description: searchJobs — keyword search. browseByRole — one TheHub job role. browseByCountry — one country or remote. allJobs — every active listing. scrapeUrls — job URLs/ids and saved /jobs? search URLs.
mode.title: What to scrape

remoteOnly.description: Only return remote-eligible jobs. Overrides the country filter.
remoteOnly.title: Remote only

role.description: TheHub role filter. Required for browseByRole; optional extra filter for searchJobs, browseByCountry and allJobs.
role.title: Job role

searchQuery.description: Keyword or job title to search for (mode=searchJobs). Case-insensitive; matches titles, companies and descriptions.
searchQuery.title: Search keyword

sortBy.description: Most popular uses the last seven days of views; New jobs uses the posting date.
sortBy.title: Sort by

urls.description: Used by mode=scrapeUrls. Accepts TheHub job URLs (https://thehub.io/jobs/<id>), bare job ids, and saved search URLs (https://thehub.io/jobs?search=...).
urls.title: Job or search URLs

title: TheHub Startup Jobs Input
